_comment: Hardware: three ODrive Pro boards (v4.4, fw 0.6.11), one axis each (axis0): X=366133543432 (confirmed), Y=367333653432, Z=365733543432. Workspace 25 x 20 in (635 x 508 mm, X x Y). Units are mm, mm/s and Nm. Coordinates are corner-origin: each axis is 0 at its homed end. Z=0 is the top and +Z moves the needle down. X/Y: IAI IS-M-X-M-20-100 (lead 20 mm -> 0.05 turns/mm; strokes X 616, Y 467 mm); max_mm from Find limits; Z turns_per_mm / max_mm are still placeholders.

z._comment: Z: IAI IS-S-Z-H-8-60-100 (60 W, lead 8 mm, stroke 100 mm). Motor: 5 pole pairs, encoder 1920 counts/rev (measured: 3058 counts = 12.7 mm). Motor + = DOWN, so homing_direction -1 (top stop). Still to do: torque constant (copied from X).

motor._comment: write_motor_config false = keep the motor/encoder/DC-bus setup already on the ODrive (set it up and calibrate in the ODrive web GUI). true = write the values below on every connect.

board._comment: Mirrors the settings configured on the boards (ODrive GUI, read back with tools.odrive_backup). null = leave whatever is on the board. NOTE: dc_max_negative_current is -inf on the board with no brake resistor - regen goes into the 48 V supply; consider -1.

_homing_mode: manual = jog (after Calibrate) or push the gantry to the home corner (X min, Y min = top-left, A1 side; Z top) and click Set home here. sensorless = Home drives into the hard stops.
_speed_percent: Start-up speed setting for every move, % of each axis speed_mm_s (change it live in System Control).
_arrive_tolerance_mm: A move is done once within this of the target and stopped (bottles are wide).
